Market today: Nervous mood due to Fed's hawkish stance on inflation and rising bond yields. This creates headwinds for your concentrated tech/chip portfolio, especially on margin, as growth stocks are sensitive to higher rates.

Your holdings: SOXL (-58.41%) and SPAL (-38.39%) are critical. Both are leveraged, decaying ETFs with deep drawdowns; their listed stops are not protective. QQQ, SMH, and QQQI are also flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep a close eye on inflation data and Fed commentary. Monitor your leveraged positions for further decay and ensure stops are truly protective.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management, especially on leveraged positions, in this nervous market.
plays: Review stops on SOXL and SPAL immediately; current stops are not protective given deep losses and leveraged decay.
Consider trimming QQQ, SMH, and QQQI as indicated, especially with rising rate concerns impacting tech.
